lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are distributed in approximately three to four horizontal rows across the visible flank, though intensity and boundaries are periodically confounded by surface caustic light patterns.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, displaying a pronounced vertical luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and a shadowed inferior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing margin of the pectoral fin features several white, elongated filamentous projections, consistent with parasitic copepod attachment or significant epidermal fraying.
